title: Ad and affiliate link watchlist
description: Destinations to check for landing health, optional Shopify buyability, and optional affiliate redirect and tracking-parameter QA. Provide ads and/or links. Hard caps: 10,000 ads, 5,000 unique URLs, 20,000 requests, 3 Shopify products, 3,600 seconds. Input may lower these caps, not raise them. Default timeout is 90 seconds to match the Store example; raise timeoutSeconds and the Actor run timeout together for bulk jobs, and leave at least 8 seconds of flush margin. The Actor detects broken affiliate redirects and unexpected tracking changes. It does not claim commission attribution.

ads.title: Ads and destinations
ads.description: Each item is one ad destination URL. Multiple ads may share a URL; results fan out every linked adId. The prefill checks example.com plus Shopify's public Dawn demo product (Thelma sandal / Black 35). You may also pass links instead of, or in addition to, ads.

adId.title: Ad ID
adId.description: Your ad or campaign identifier. Not fetched remotely.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Optional platform label: meta, tiktok, google, linkedin, or other. Not fetched remotely.

destinationUrl.title: Destination URL
destinationUrl.description: HTTPS landing URL to check (read-only GET).

expectedDomain.title: Expected domain
expectedDomain.description: If set, a final redirect host outside this domain is a failure.

requiredText.title: Required text
requiredText.description: All of these substrings must appear in the final HTML body.

forbiddenText.title: Forbidden text
forbiddenText.description: If any substring appears, the destination fails assertions (e.g. Sold out).

shopifyProductUrl.title: Shopify product URL
shopifyProductUrl.description: Optional. When set with variantId, also checks /products/{handle}.js.

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional label for this ad row. Not sent to destinations.

requiredParams.title: Required tracking parameters
requiredParams.description: Parameters to inspect. A missing parameter is not an automatic failure unless severity is error.

name.title: Parameter name
name.description: Query parameter to inspect, for example awinaffid or tag.

expectedValue.title: Expected value
expectedValue.description: Optional. Compared only against this parameter on the start URL, not against a network-issued click ID after a rename.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Other names that count as the same parameter (for example awc for awinaffid).

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: info, warning, or error. Default is warning, so a missing or consumed parameter is not an automatic failure.

enableShopifyChecks.title: Enable Shopify checks
enableShopifyChecks.description: When false, shopifyProductUrl / variantId fields are ignored and no Shopify request is sent.

previousSnapshot.title: Previous snapshot
previousSnapshot.description: Optional OUTPUT.snapshot from an earlier run. Used for two-strike confirmation when you are not on a saved Apify task.

stateScope.title: State scope
stateScope.description: Optional persistence name for local or non-task runs. An Apify task ID always wins so two tasks cannot share state by accident.

maxAds.title: Ad cap
maxAds.description: Optional ad count cap of 10,000 or less.

maxUniqueUrls.title: Unique URL cap
maxUniqueUrls.description: Optional unique destination URL cap of 5,000 or less.

maxRequests.title: Request cap
maxRequests.description: Optional HTTP request budget of 20,000 or less (robots, redirects, retries included).

maxShopifyProducts.title: Shopify product cap
maxShopifyProducts.description: Optional Shopify product cap of 3 or less.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout seconds
timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock budget for this run, clamped to the remaining Actor run timeout minus 15 seconds. Default is 90 seconds for the Store example. For bulk HTTP checks, set this and the Actor run timeout together. Leave at least 8 seconds of flush margin so leftover URLs are written as timeout rows. A practical starting point is about 1 second per unique URL divided by concurrency, then add waiting time when many URLs share a host (requests to the same host are spaced and limited to 2 in flight by default). Example: 2,000 links across a few hosts often need a 15-20 minute run timeout. Browser mode needs several seconds per URL and 1024 MB.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent URLs
maxConcurrency.description: How many destination checks may run at once. Default 10, maximum 20. Per-host limits still apply.

maxConcurrencyPerHost.title: Max concurrent requests per host
maxConcurrencyPerHost.description: In-flight HTTP requests allowed against one hostname. Default and maximum are 2 so bulk runs do not hammer a single host.

rateLimitMs.title: Per-host spacing (ms)
rateLimitMs.description: Minimum time between starting requests to the same hostname, in milliseconds. Default 400, minimum 200, maximum 10,000. Use a higher value to be gentler on one host.

confirmFailures.title: Confirm failures (strikes)
confirmFailures.description: Consecutive failure observations required before confirmedFailure / confirmedShopifyFailure. Default 2. Cannot exceed 2.

links.title: Affiliate or tracking links
links.description: Optional alternative to ads. Each item needs a url or destinationUrl. Same fields as ads, plus optional per-link requiredParams. Used with ads, or on its own.

url.title: Link URL
url.description: HTTPS tracking or destination URL (read-only GET). Same as destinationUrl.

destinationUrl.title: Destination URL
destinationUrl.description: Alternative field name for the same HTTPS URL.

expectedDomain.title: Expected final domain
expectedDomain.description: If set, a final host outside this domain is a failure.

requiredParams.title: Required tracking parameters
requiredParams.description: Parameters to inspect. A missing parameter is not an automatic failure unless severity is error.

name.title: Parameter name
name.description: Query parameter to inspect, for example awinaffid or tag.

expectedValue.title: Expected value
expectedValue.description: Optional. Compared only against this parameter on the start URL, not against a network-issued click ID after a rename.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Other names that count as the same parameter (for example awc for awinaffid).

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: info, warning, or error. Default is warning, so a missing or consumed parameter is not an automatic failure.

adId.title: Ad or link ID
adId.description: Your ad or campaign identifier. Not fetched remotely.

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional label for this link. Not sent to destinations.

requiredText.title: Required text
requiredText.description: All of these substrings must appear in the final HTML body.

forbiddenText.title: Forbidden text
forbiddenText.description: If any substring appears, the destination fails assertions.

requiredParams.title: Global required tracking parameters
requiredParams.description: Inspect these query parameters across every link. Default severity is warning, so a missing or consumed parameter is not an automatic failure. Networks may drop or rename parameters; add aliases or per-hop rules for that.

name.title: Parameter name
name.description: Query parameter to inspect, for example awinaffid or tag.

expectedValue.title: Expected value
expectedValue.description: Optional. Compared only against this parameter on the start URL, not against a network-issued click ID after a rename.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Other names that count as the same parameter (for example awc for awinaffid).

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: info, warning, or error. Default is warning, so a missing or consumed parameter is not an automatic failure.

paramRules.title: Parameter validation rules
paramRules.description: Configurable validation. aliases maps a required name to other names (for example clickref to awc). perHop is a list of {hostSuffix, mayDrop, mayRename} rules. useDefaultNetworkRules (default true) applies built-in consume/rename rules for Awin, Impact, CJ and Amazon-style hosts. defaultSeverity is info, warning, or error (default warning).

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Map of parameter name to a list of alias names.

perHop.title: Per-hop rules

hostSuffix.title: Host suffix
hostSuffix.description: Hostname suffix to match, for example awin1.com.

mayDrop.title: May drop
mayDrop.description: Parameter names this host may legitimately drop.

mayRename.title: May rename
mayRename.description: Map of original parameter names to the names this host may emit instead.

perHop.description: Host-specific consume and rename rules applied when a parameter disappears after that host.

useDefaultNetworkRules.title: Use built-in network rules
useDefaultNetworkRules.description: When true (default), apply built-in consume and rename rules for Awin, Impact, CJ and Amazon-style hosts.

defaultSeverity.title: Default severity
defaultSeverity.description: Severity used when a required parameter does not set its own. Default is warning.

renderMode.title: Render mode
renderMode.description: http is the default fast mode (Location headers, plus meta-refresh and simple JS redirects when followClientRedirects is on). browser uses a headless Chromium render for JS-driven or meta-refresh chains. Use a higher memory run (1024 MB) for browser mode. The Store example stays on http.

followClientRedirects.title: Follow meta-refresh and simple JS redirects in HTTP mode
followClientRedirects.description: When true, HTTP mode also follows meta-refresh and simple location.href / location.replace assignments found in HTML. Defaults to true when affiliate fields are used, and false for classic ads-only inputs so existing behaviour stays the same.

respectRobots.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobots.description: When true (default), the Actor fetches robots.txt and skips disallowed paths. Set false to inspect specific tracking URLs you own when a network's robots.txt would otherwise block the check.
